status: frozen before querying any of the 141 member coordinates in NSC DR2, seeing any member-level NSC candidate response, selecting an HSC or NSC counterpart, applying a photometric quality cut or filter transformation, deriving a stellar mass, constructing a mass-current map, opening replacement-cluster lensing targets, or changing gravity physics
purpose: Acquire every NOIRLab Source Catalog DR2 candidate around the frozen spectroscopic members and losslessly extract the Bullet paper's published Bessel B/R/I constraints so a later protocol can design a global probabilistic association without nearest-neighbor tuning.

source.query_language: Data Lab TAP SQL/ADQL subset using lower-case q3c_radial_query and the required boolean comparison 't'=q3c_radial_query(...) followed by ORDER BY id
source.coordinate_frame: J2000/ICRS degrees from the V19D primary-paper catalogs
source.pre_freeze_metadata_check: TAP_SCHEMA reported nsc_dr2.object and the exact requested column names and meanings. No member coordinate was queried.
source.source_choice: NSC DR2 was chosen before member-level queries because center-only preflight showed coverage in both fields, whereas DES DR2 returned no Bullet-center rows.

published_bullet_photometry.filters: ESO VLT FORS1 Bessel B, R and I
published_bullet_photometry.reported_field: 6 arcmin by 6 arcmin centered at RA 06:58:29, Dec -55:57:22 J2000
published_bullet_photometry.derived_quantities: R=B-(B-R) and I=B-(B-I) are exact algebraic reconstructions of the reported table columns, not a filter transformation or fitted quantity.

BULLET.radius_basis: Unchanged from V19Y: whole-time-second right ascension quantization gives a half-bin sky extent of about 4.2 arcsec at declination -56 degrees.

ABELL2146.radius_basis: Unchanged from V19Y: primary coordinates are reported to 0.0001 degree.

outputs.per_member_payloads: one untouched NSC CSV, one exact ADQL text file and one exact query-URL text file per published member

gates.failure_rule: Fail before matching or mass inference. Do not change radii, columns, catalog release, query ordering, keep only photometrically attractive candidates, reinterpret 99.99 sentinels, select an HSC/NSC counterpart, or query lensing or inferred-halo products.

downstream_boundary.next_protocol: After V19Z reports candidate and band coverage, freeze a global association likelihood with positional quantization, proper-motion and morphology evidence, published Bullet Bessel colors, a null-match state, one-to-one constraints and explicit posterior ambiguity.
downstream_boundary.no_nearest_neighbor_rule: The matching protocol may use angular separation as one likelihood factor but cannot declare the nearest row correct or tune a hard radius after seeing candidate identities.
downstream_boundary.no_filter_equivalence: Published Bessel B/R/I, NSC passbands and HST ACS passbands are not interchangeable. Any color term, k-correction or SED model must be frozen and uncertainty-propagated before use.
downstream_boundary.mass_current_claim: Successful photometry supplies a projected stellar-mass times line-of-sight-velocity proxy. Transverse velocity and unobserved member incompleteness remain explicit uncertainties.
